audiences.jobToBeDone: Qualify a construction, HVAC, modernization or facilities opportunity and understand TCCG's delivery path.
Evaluate TCCG for compliant project pursuit and delivery.
Understand how to participate in approved project delivery.

offers.description: Construction/HVAC modernization and coordination services subject to current licensing and service-area authority.

valueProposition: Disciplined construction and facility modernization with smart HVAC, BIM coordination, project controls and evidence-backed delivery.
differentiators: Portfolio access to Tolani Labs and TSG capabilities
prohibitedClaims: License or certification claims without current evidence
Guaranteed schedule, savings or award outcomes
Internal design commentary presented as customer copy

legalAndCompliance.rule: Licensing, bonding, insurance, project-size and geographic claims require current launch-control-book evidence before publication.
